contexts.text: The Church signified by Noah continued to the time of Abram.
Abraham represented saving faith.
The first style of the Word is used up to the time of Abram... The historical style is used from the time of Abram. AC 66:2.
Abraham represented celestial love, Isaac, spiritual love; these are of the inward man; Jacob represented the same, but of the outward man. Illustrated.
Since Abram represented love or saving faith, his seed means all in the universe who are in love. Illustrated.
Celestial love represented by Abraham is as the father of spiritual love represented by Isaac, for the spiritual is born from the celestial.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob mean all who are in love.
Because Abraham represented the celestial things of faith, he sojourned in the land of the Philistines, and entered into a covenant with them.
Abram, Nahor, and Haran were persons, from whom nations also were named that were idolaters. AC 1358. AC 1362, Explained.
Abram was an idolater and knew not Jehovah. AC 1360.
Abram, Nahor and Haran, as nations, = idolatrous worships. AC 1363.

In consequence of being idolaters, and not knowing Jehovah, or what is the good and truth of faith, Terah and Abram were better fitted to receive the seed of truth than others in Syria with whom knowledges still remained...
Abram and Nahor took wives; the name of Abram's wife was Sarai = the marriages of evil with falsity in idolatrous worship.

Terah took Abram his son, and Lot... and went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees to go into the Land of Canaan; and they came even to Haran, and remained there = that those who were in idolatrous worship were instructed in celestial and spiritual things of faith, in order that a representative Church might exist therefrom.
Terah died in Haran = the end of idolatry and the beginning of a representative Church by Abram.
What is said in this chapter about Abram represents the Lord's state from earliest childhood to adolescence.
What is said about the sojourn of Abram in Egypt = the Lord's first instruction.
Abram, in general, represents the Lord; specifically, the celestial man.
Abram represents the Lord. AC 1420. AC 1543. AC 1906. AC 2769. AC 2780. AC 2862. AC 2915.
The Representative Church began with Abram.
Abram represents the Lord, and therefore also the celestial man; Isaac, the Lord and thence the spiritual man, and Jacob the Lord and thence the natural man corresponding to the spiritual.
Jehovah said to Abram = the very first act of taking notice.
The land of his birth, from which Abram went out, was idolatrous.
By Abram is represented the Lord as to His human essence; afterwards as to both the human and the Divine essence, and then he is called Abraham.
Abram took Sarai his wife = good to which truth was adjoined. Explained.
Abram here means the Lord when He was a child.
Abram went through the land to the place Shechem = the Lord's second state. Explained.
Jehovah seen by Abram = that Jehovah appeared to the Lord when as yet a child.
And Abram went down to sojourn in Egypt = instruction in knowledges from the Word. AC 1479. AC 1502. Illustrated. AC 1542.
Pharaoh treated Abram well for her sake = that scientifics were multiplied with the Lord.
And Pharaoh called Abram = that the Lord remembered.
The Lord's outward man or human essence is represented in this chapter by Lot, and His inward man or Divine essence, by Abram. AC 1568. AC 1590.
Abram went up from Egypt = from scientifics, which left the Lord.
Abram = what was celestial in the Lord, thus he and his wife = the celestial truths then in the Lord. AC 1655.
Abram was very heavy with cattle, silver and gold = the goods, truths, and goods from truths with which the Lord was then enriched.
Lot going with Abram = the outward man that was with the Lord.
Signification of the separation of Lot from Abram.
A dispute between the shepherds of Abram's cattle, and the shepherds of Lot's cattle = that the inward man and the outward man did not agree. AC 1572.
And Abram said unto Lot = thus said the inward man to the outward... Abram represents the inward man relatively to Lot, who is that in the outward man which is to be separated.
The things that agree are Abram, even those in the outward man, for these constitute one thing with the inward man, and belong to it.
Abram dwelt in the land of Canaan = that the inward man was in the celestial things of love.
Jehovah said to Abram = that Jehovah thus spake to the Lord.
Abram pitched his tent and came and dwelt in the oak grove Mamre, which is in Hebron = that the Lord came to a still more inward perception.
Abram the Hebrew = the rational man.
Abram the Hebrew = the interior man to which the inward or Divine man is adjoined. AC 1701. AC 1707.
Why Abram is here called the Hebrew. AC 1732:end.
Abram heard that his brother was made captive = the interior man perceived in what kind of state the outward man was.
Abram here = the inward man in the interior or middle man.
(Abram) = the rational man. Explained.
Abram blessed God Most High = that the Lord's interior or rational man had enjoyment of goods from His inward man.
Abram = the Lord's rational.

In the two preceding chapters Abram represented the Lord and His state in childhood; in this chapter he represents the Lord's rational, and is then called Abram the Hebrew. No other Abram is understood in this chapter than Abram the Hebrew. The Spiritual of the Lord that was adjoined to the inward man is Abram the Hebrew, but the Celestial is represented by Melchizedek.
Abram here represents the Lord now a conqueror.
Lest thou shouldst say, I have enriched Abram = that hence the Lord derived no strength.
After these words the word of Jehovah came to Abram in vision = that after combats in childhood there was revelation.
Abram said, O Lord Jehovih = the Lord's perception; Abram is the interior man, Lord Jehovih, the inward relatively to the interior man.
Abram said, Lo to me Thou hast not given seed = that there was nothing inward of the Church. AC 1741.
Abraham is not known in Heaven. AC 1876. AC 1989. AC 2658:end.
Abram drove them away = the Lord put them to flight.
Sleep fell upon Abram = that the Church was then in falsities.
Jehovah made a covenant with Abram = the conjunction of the Lord's interior with His inward man.
The seed of Abram = love and faith thence, thus all who are in charity and faith in the Lord.
In this chapter Abram is the inward man of the Lord, who is Jehovah. AC 1894. AC 1898. AC 1960.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob represent the inward, the rational, and the natural man. AC 1950, Explained.
Abram said to Sarai = perception. The Lord's perception is signified by Abram said to Sarai, but thought from perception by Sarai said to Abram.
Abram was a son of eighty years and six years = the Lord's state as to celestial goods acquired through the combats of temptations.
Hence it is that Abram also represents the celestial Church and the celestial man, as well as what is celestial itself.
Abram was a son of ninety years and nine years = the time before the Lord fully conjoined the inward man with the rational.

The reason of Abram's long waiting in the Land of Canaan before Sarai had a son was that he thereby represented the union of the Lord's Divine and Human Essence, and in fact that of His inward man, which was Jehovah, with His Rational. AC 2636:3.

That Abram signifies the Lord in that state and at that age is evident from what has already been said about Abram. In the inward sense Abram represents the Lord, for no other Abram is understood in Heaven when he is named in the Word. They who have been born within the Church, and have heard about him from the Word, do indeed know of him when they enter the other life, but as he is like any other individual, and cannot be of any help to them, they no longer concern themselves about him; and they are informed that by Abram in the Word no other is understood than the Lord. But the Angels... are altogether ignorant of Abram, wherefore when the Word is read by man, and Abram is mentioned, they perceive no other than the Lord, and at these words they perceive the Lord in that state and at that age, for here Jehovah speaks with Abram, that is, with the Lord. AC 2077. AC 3703:4.
I am God Shaddai, in the sense of the letter, signifies the name of Abram's god. Explained.

Hence it is evident that Abram in his youth was like other gentiles, namely an idolater, and that even yet, when he was in Canaan, he had not rejected from his mind the god Shaddai, by which name the Lord was first represented to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. AC 1998. AC 2010. AC 2559. AC 3667.
Abram here represents the interior man. Explained.
Thy name shall no more be called Abram = that He would put off the Human, and Abraham shall thy name be = that He would put on the Divine.

That Abram served other gods and worshipped the god Shaddai has been shown above, but as he represented the Lord, and in fact His Internal Man, thus the Celestial of His love, therefore his former quality was to be destroyed, that is, the name Abram was to be changed into another quality, by which he could represent the Lord. Therefore the letter H was taken from the name Jehovah, being the only letter in that name which involves the Divine, and signifies I AM, or TO BE, and was inserted in the name Abram. In like manner with Sarai... Hence it is evident that in the inward sense of the Word Abraham represents. Jehovah or the Lord. AC 1416:2. AC 3251.
A new perception of the Lord is expressed by God said unto Abraham, as in other places.

The Divine good, which is love, and relatively to the universal human race is mercy, was the internal of the Lord, that is, Jehovah, who is good itself; this was represented by Abraham, and the truth conjoined to the Divine good was represented by Sarai. AC 2069:3. AC 2093. AC 2517. AC 2622. AC 2628. AC 2643. AC 2653. AC 2656.
God went up from Abraham = the entrance of the Lord into the former state.
Abraham a son of ninety and nine years = the state and time before the union of the Lord's Divine essence with His human one.

Abraham was circumcised and Ishmael his son = that when the Lord conjoined His human essence to the Divine one, He also conjoined to Himself the rest who become rational by means of truth, and saved them.
Abraham's speaking with Jehovah about the overthrow of Sodom and Gomorrah = the Lord's intercession for mankind.
The subject here treated of in the inward sense is the Lord and His perception, which was represented by the appearance of Jehovah to Abraham (in the oak-grove of Mamre).
Abraham ran to meet them = that the Lord approached more closely to the things that were perceived.
Abraham hastened towards the tent to Sarah = the Lord's rational good conjoined to His truth. AC 2172. AC 2204.
When Abraham speaks with Jehovah, he represents the Lord in the Human... otherwise Abraham represents the Lord's Divine Good... hence here, rational good. AC 2180. AC 2198.
Sacrifices emanated from the Hebrew Church to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
Many shall lie down with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob = they shall enjoy the celestial goods which these names signify.
The coming of Jehovah to Abraham = Divine perception for which the Lord prepared Himself, thus conjunction.
Abraham and Sarah were old = that the Human with the Lord was to be put off.

This time of life denotes the time when Abraham would enter upon his hundredth year, by which year is signified the unition of the Lord's Human with the Divine, and of the Divine with the Human. AC 2636.
Abraham going with them = that the Lord still remained in perception with those things, or concerning mankind.
Shall I hide from Abraham what I am doing? = that nothing ought to he hidden before the Lord. Abraham represents the Lord in that state.
Abraham in being shall be for a nation great and numerous = that all good and all truth thence will be from the Lord.
That Jehovah may bring upon Abraham what was spoken upon him = that therefore the human essence will be adjoined to the Divine essence.

Abraham, he was still standing before Jehovah = the Lord's thought from the Human, that it was adjoined in the way that was said. Abraham in this chapter is the Lord as to the Human. AC 2265. AC 2287.
Abraham drew near and said = the Lord's thought from the Human which adjoined itself more closely to the Divine.
Abraham answered and said = the Lord's thought from the Human.
Abraham returned to his place = the Lord returned into the state in which He was before He perceived these things.
Abraham in the inward sense is nothing but love itself, i.e., the Lord.
Abraham rose up in the morning = the Lord's thought about the last time.
And God remembered Abraham = salvation through the unition of the Lord's Divine essence with His human essence.
The sojourn of Abraham in Gerar = the instruction of the Lord in the doctrinal things of charity and faith. AC 2504.
Abraham journeyed thence towards the land of the south = the Lord's progress in the goods and truths of faith.
Abraham is the Lord in that state, as before. AC 2545.
Abraham, when called the man = celestial truth, which is the same as doctrine from a celestial origin.

Since the first scientifics and the rational things therefrom were human with the Lord, being imbued with what was hereditary from the mother, thus were not purely Divine, they are therefore represented by Abraham's first state. (i.e. when he was an idolater.) See also AC 1816.
Abraham = celestial good conjoined with spiritual truth (Sarah).
Many of the Jews are there introduced to Abraham, Jacob, etc.
Abraham represents the Divine Celestial or Divine good.
Abraham represents the Lord as to the Divine Celestial or Divine good.
Abraham represents the supreme Divine; Isaac, the Divine Rational, and Jacob the Divine Natural.
God said to Abraham = the Lord's perception from the Divine.
Abraham rose up in the morning = the Lord's clear perception from the Divine.
Abraham reproved Abimelech = the Lord's indignation.
Abraham sojourned in the land of the Philistines many days = that the Lord adjoined many things from the science of human knowledges to the doctrine of faith.
And God tempted Abraham = the most grievous and deep temptations of the Lord.
Abraham here = the Lord's Divine, and Isaac, His Divine Human. AC 2816.
Isaac said to Abraham his father, and he said, My father, and he said, Behold me, my son = colloquy of the Lord from the love of Divine truth with Divine good.
And Abraham let go his hand = temptation even to the last of power.
Abraham inclined to the practice of sacrificing children.
Abraham here = the Divine good of the Lord's Rational or Human.
Abraham lifted up his eyes and saw = the Lord's thought and intuition from the Divine.

Abraham went and took the ram = their deliverance by means of the Lord's Divine Human... When Jehovah or the Angel of Jehovah speaks with Abraham, Jehovah or the Angel of Jehovah is the Divine Itself, and Abraham is the Divine Human. AC 2836. AC 3017. AC 3032. AC 3061. AC 3064. AC 3119.
The Angel of Jehovah cried to Abraham a second time out of heaven = consolation of the Lord still greater.

That Jehovah swore to give the land to Abraham, Isaac and Jacob, or their descendants, in the inward sense signifies confirmation that He would give the heavenly kingdom to those who are in love and faith in Him. These are they who are understood in the inward sense by the sons and descendants of Abraham, Isaac and Jacob.
Abraham returned to his boys = conjunction again with the former Rational.
Abraham dwelt in Beersheba = that the Lord is the doctrine of charity and faith itself.
That Hebron was the region where Abraham, Isaac and Jacob dwelt.
Abraham came to mourn for Sarah, and to weep for her = the Lord's state of grief on account of night as to the truths of faith in the Church.
Abraham arose and bowed himself = the Lord's joy on account of a kind reception.
(Not to receive silver from Abraham) = not to wish to be redeemed by the Lord, but by themselves.
Abraham bowed himself before the people of the land = the Lord's joy on account of the goodwill of those who were of the new Spiritual Church.

To Abraham for an acquisition = that they were accepted as being of the Lord alone, namely all the quality and quantity of regeneration, as to the good and truth of faith, and thus as to all knowledges both interior and exterior. AC 2985.
Abraham buried Sarah his wife = they received from the Lord truth conjoined with good.
Abraham, when called, was a Gentile.
Abraham being old came to days = when the state was at hand that the Lord's Human should become Divine.

Jehovah blessed Abraham in all things = when all things had been arranged in Divine order by the Lord... Jehovah is the Lord as to the Divine Itself, and then Abraham represents the Lord as to the Divine Human; wherefore when it is said that Jehovah blessed Abraham in all things, it is meant in the inward sense that the Lord, from the Divine Itself, arranged all things in Divine order in His Human.
Abraham said to his elder servant of his house = the orderly arrangement and influx of the Lord into His Natural.

Abraham being old came to days, and Jehovah blessed Abraham in all things = when the state was at hand that the Lord's Human would become Divine, and that all things would be arranged in Divine order.
From this it is evident that the land from which Abram came was Syria, where was the second Ancient Church, which was called Hebrew.
Abraham said to [his servant] = the Lord's perception from the Divine... Abraham represents the Lord as to the Divine Human, from which comes this perception.
Jehovah God of my lord Abraham = the communication of the Divine Itself which is the Father with the Divine Human which is the Son... Abraham represents His Divine Human. AC 3064. AC 3119.
Jehovah God will give truth to Jacob, mercy to Abraham, () where Jacob stands for the Lord's outward man, Abraham for the inward man as to the Human.

Abraham added and took a woman = the second state of the Lord which Abraham here represents. Abraham and Sarah = the Lord as to the Divine Celestial, and Abraham and Keturah, as to the Divine Spiritual.
Abraham here represents the Lord as to Divine spiritual good.
Abraham = the Lord as to Divine spiritual good, Keturah, as to Divine spiritual truth conjoined to that good; hence their sons = common lots of the Lord's Spiritual Kingdom. Explained.

Abraham gave all things that he had to Isaac, in the highest senses all Divine things in the Divine Rational, and in the relative sense, the celestial things of love in the Lord's Celestial Kingdom, for Abraham is the Lord as to the Divine Itself.
And to the sons of the concubines that Abraham had, Abraham gave presents = the spiritual [men and angels] adopted by the Lord's Divine Human.
Abraham here represents the Lord as to the Divine Human.
These are the days of the years of the lives of Abraham that he lived = the [end of the] representative state of the Lord as to the Divine Itself by Abraham.

Abraham represented the Divine Itself called the Father, and the Divine Human called the Son, thus the Lord as to both, but it was the Divine Human from eternity from which existed and to which He reduced the Human born in time: this is the representation of the Lord by Abraham.
And Abraham expired and died = the end of the representation of the Lord by Abraham. See also AC 3230. AC 3259.
Sons of Abraham = those who are in truth from the Lord, for Abraham represents the Lord as to the Divine Human also.
Abraham begat Isaac = from the Divine Itself the Divine Rational.
To recline with Abraham, Isaac and Jacob = to be with the Lord; and to be in Abraham's bosom = to be in the Lord. AC 3708:13.

They said, We are the seed of Abraham; Abraham is our father; Jesus said unto them, If ye were sons of Abraham, ye would do the works of Abraham... By Abraham here, the Lord is understood, as everywhere in the Word.
Abraham hearkened to My voice = the union of the Lord's Divine essence with the human essence through temptations, for Abraham is the Lord as to the Divine Human also.
Abraham here represents the Lord's Divine Itself.

Where days denote states, Abraham his father represents the Lord's Divine Itself before He adjoined the Human to Himself; when they denote times, Abraham his father represents the goods and truths that were from the Lord's Divine before He adjoined the Human, thus which the Ancients had.
I am the God of Abraham thy father = that the Divine was there also; for Abraham represents the Divine of the Lord. AC 4352 1.2.
For the sake of Abraham My servant = from the Lord's Divine Human; for Abraham = the Divine of the Lord and the Divine Human also.
He shall give thee the blessing of Abraham = the conjunction of the Divine Itself with good and truth natural (Jacob).

The Most Ancient Church was in the Land of Canaan... and also the Ancient Church... Hence all the places etc. there became representative... This was the reason why Abraham was commanded to go there... AC 4447:2. AC 5136.

I am Jehovah the God of Abraham thy father = the Lord, and that from Him is that good... Jehovah is the Lord's Divine Esse itself, and is called the God of Abraham from Divine Good... Abraham represents the Lord as to Divine Good. And since Divine Good is the source of all celestial and spiritual goods, and thence also of all truths, he is here called Abraham thy father, that is, of Jacob, although he was the father of Isaac. Illustrated.
Abraham = the highest sense of the Word.
After Abram had been called out of Syria, Syria put on the representation of a region outside of the Church.
Abraham with Isaac represents Divine good flowing in directly.
The God of Abraham = the Divine Itself which is called the Divine essence.

The God of Abraham = the Lord's Divine paying regard to those who are within the Church... For Abraham represents the Lord's Divine, consequently that which comes from the Lord directly; hence they who are within the Church are specifically understood by the sons of Abraham.
Hence, in the relative sense, Abraham represents the genuine Church, and Nahor, the Church of the Gentiles. AC 3778, Explained.
The family of Abraham were enjoined to acknowledge Jehovah as their God, but still they only acknowledged Him as another god...
It was not [all] the descendants of Abraham that represented the Church. Explained.
Circumcision was not enjoined to Abraham and his descendants as anything new, but as something intermitted that was to be restored.
Abraham and Isaac represent the Lord's Divine; Abraham, the Divine Itself, and Isaac, the Divine Human; specifically, the Divine Rational of the Lord. References.
Where Abraham and Isaac sojourned = the Divine life; for Abraham = the Lord's Divine Itself, and Isaac, His Divine Rational. Explained.

When Abraham, Isaac and Jacob are mentioned, in the highest sense they represent the Lord, namely, Abraham, His Divine Itself, Isaac, His Divine Intellectual, and Jacob, His Divine Natural. AC 5307:2. AC 6098, References. AC 6185.
Hence Abraham represents also the celestial with man, Isaac, the spiritual, and Jacob, the natural.
Hence in the relative sense, with man, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob represent what is inmost, which is celestial good; what is interior, which is spiritual good; and what is outer, which is natural good.

In the highest sense, Abraham represents the Lord's Divine Itself, and Isaac, His Divine Rational, thus the inward Human, for Jacob = the Lord's Divine Natural, or His outward Human; but in the representative sense, Abraham = inward good, and Isaac, inward truth. AC 6284. AC 6434.
In the relative sense Abraham and Isaac represent what is inward of the Kingdom and Church of the Lord.
Abraham represents what is inmost, and Isaac, what is interior, under what is inmost.
In the highest sense, Abraham represents the Lord. AC 6549.
In the relative sense, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob represent the Lord's Kingdom as to what is inward and outward of it. AC 6589.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob represent the Lord's Divine Human. Illustrated. AC 7195. AC 7211, Explained.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob represent the Lord's Divine Itself and the Divine Human. AC 6885. AC 6894. HH 526:4.
To be carried into Abraham's bosom = to the Lord, who is understood by Abraham, from conjunction through love.
Abraham here = the celestial in the Human before it was made Divine; Isaac, the spiritual, and Jacob, the natural.
Abraham in the highest sense represents the Lord, and in the relative sense, those in Heaven who are in the good of love and of faith in the Lord. References.
Abraham, Isaac and Israel = Heaven and the Church; because Abraham, Isaac and Israel = the Lord as to the Divine Human, thus as to His Divine in Heaven and the Church. Illustrated. AC 10445.
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the highest sense = the Lord as to the Divine Itself and the Divine Human; and in the relative sense, Heaven and the Church. References. AE 232:3. References.
That it was the Lord who was seen by Abraham, etc.
The Jews are there introduced to Abraham, David, etc., or to Spirits who take their place...
The Angels know where Abraham, etc. are; they are held in no higher estimation than others...
Instead of the names Abraham, Isaac and Jacob in the Word in Heaven, there is the Lord as to the Divine and the Divine Human. See TCR 241:2.
Abraham was in the spirit when he saw the three Angels.
The tabernacle of Abraham to which the three Angels came, seen.
(Feasting with Abram, Isaac and Jacob acted there. Described.)
Abraham, Isaac and Jacob = the Lord as to the Divine Celestial, the Divine Spiritual and the Divine Natural. TCR 724. AE 696:24.
Abraham and Isaac seen. WE 1528. WE 5588. (See SE 281.) SE 410. SE 461. SE 2873. SE 2919.
The infidelity of Abraham was transplanted into Jacob and his descendants. SEIndex1 4.
Abraham and others were in this state of interior wakefulness when they saw Angels...
Spirits tried to pronounce Abraham, but could not...
Abraham's bosom = the Divine Truth that is in Heaven, for they who are in it are with the Lord, who is represented by Abraham. AE 455:7.
Abraham in the highest sense means the Lord, and in the relative sense, the Lord's Celestial Kingdom and Celestial Church.
